prospective_holdout.admission_rule: event.available_at > prospective_holdout_cutoff and event passes the frozen source/event eligibility law before outcome access
prospective_holdout.note: Future events append through the existing source/experiment owner; this file does not create a watcher or collector.

first_pass_measurement_rule.rationale: Avoid outcome-tuned impulse-end detection in the first development pass.
causal_features: signed causal-proxy return over trailing 60 minutes before available_at
signed causal-proxy return over trailing 240 minutes before available_at
signed causal-proxy return from prior regular-session close where available
signed causal-proxy move from available_at to +5 minutes
first_pass_measurement_rule.response_feature: response cohort return minus benchmark return from +5 minutes to +35 minutes
first_pass_measurement_rule.note: All signs are defined from the event's predeclared expected causal direction. No threshold is selected from September 24.
